author: Alec Ng
title: Perfect design collection for my travel memories
body:
I first came across CityFrame during a summer holiday in Frankfurt with my family. As an architect, I’ve always had a love for architectural models, so the moment I saw your products, I immediately thought it would be such a great way to collect the cities and places we have visited together in a three-dimensional form.
CityFrame has really become the perfect “gift” for both myself and my family. So far, I have purchased 15 models in the cube format, and I am pretty sure this is only the beginning. There are still quite a few places we have visited that I have not yet added to the collection, and of course we will continue travelling in the future. My plan is to gradually collect as many of those special places as possible through CityFrame.
Overall, I am extremely happy with the quality of the products, the design, and the very fast delivery. It has been a wonderful experience so far, and I am looking forward to continuing to grow the collection.

Their packaging is not only highly protective but also easy to open and unpack, which is a detail I truly appreciate.
With my most recent order, however, the Display Cover arrived with a small scratch that unfortunately affected the desired effect. I reached out to customer service, and to my surprise and delight, I had a brand-new, flawless replacement in my home the very next day. That level of responsiveness and commitment to customer satisfaction is rare, and it only reinforces why I continue to shop with City Frames.
Fantastic products and outstanding service—highly recommended!
